questions.q: Under s32B(1), what is FRV responsible for?
questions.a: The control and direction of all members of units in the FRV fire district

questions.q: Under s32B(2), how must members proceed to an alarm of fire?
questions.a: With all practical speed

questions.q: Under s32B(3)(b), who has control and direction of any unit present and all persons assisting at the scene?
questions.a: The senior member of the operational staff

questions.q: Under s32B(4), which actions carry no liability to any penalty or claim?
questions.a: Shutting off water, closing roads/waterways/railways/tramways, or shutting off gas, electricity, oil or power (s32B(3)(c)(iii) and (iv))

questions.q: Under s54A, immunity applies to acts done in what manner?
questions.a: In good faith (or in the reasonable belief the act was within the power)

questions.q: Under s54(3), does a contrary clause in an insurance policy stop damage being treated as fire damage?
questions.a: No – s54(2) applies despite any contrary clause or condition

questions.q: Under s61(1), what must every police officer present at a fire do?
questions.a: Support and assist the senior member of operational staff in maintaining their authority and enforcing compliance with their orders

questions.q: Under s59, how much do FRV pay for water used for firefighting or drills?
questions.a: Nothing – it is free of charge
